name: Multi-Light Rendering & Relighting Integration
definition: Computes pixel color by integrating BRDF, light visibility, cosine factor, and light area over all lights, with optional support for environment maps, OLAT relighting, and light probe relighting.
summary: Multi-Light Rendering & Relighting Integration computes pixel color by integrating BRDF, visibility, and light area over discrete sources, distinguished by its explicit handling of multiple lights and probe-based relighting scaling.
